name: Corning 3474 96 well ULA
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning Costar 96 well clear polystyrene plate, flat clear bottom, Ultra-Low Attachment surface (covalently bonded hydrogel), with low-evaporation lid, individually wrapped, sterile, 1 per pack, 24 per case. Units in meters. Corning publishes no per-catalog drawing for its assay plates, so the controlling document is the family sheet 'Microplate Dimensions 96/384/1536', row '96 well flat bottom' under 'Solid black, white, and clear polystyrene plates', where 3474 is named explicitly alongside 3599, 3300 and the other solid-bottom 96-well plates; no dimension here was measured on a 3474 specifically. From that row: well spacing (pitch) 9 mm; A1 well center 14.3 mm from the left edge (Corning 'A1 column offset') and 11.2 mm from the top edge ('A1 row offset'); well depth 10.67 mm; well diameter 6.86 mm at the top and 6.35 mm at the bottom (Corning does not say in words the well is round; inferred from its 'top/bottom' diameter column, against the '(width)' annotation on its square 384-well rows); flange/skirt height 6.096 mm; stack height 12.97 mm; well bottom thickness 1.27 mm; 'distance to bottom of plate' 2.26 mm, recorded as bottom_elevation (underside of the well bottom above the resting plane); 'well bottom elevation' 3.55 mm, recorded as floor_height. These two do not quite close: 2.26 + 1.27 = 3.53 mm, not 3.55 mm; each is recorded as printed. Well bottom area 0.3165 cm^2, which gives a bottom diameter of 6.35 mm, agreeing with the printed one; total well volume 360 uL. Plate footprint 127.76 x 85.48 mm and height without lid 14.22 mm per the Corning and Falcon Microplates Selection Guide (CLS-C-DL-MP-014REV9), which Corning states meets the ANSI/SBS footprint standard; the family sheet rounds this to 127.8 x 85.5 x 14.2 mm. Cross-checked against the per-catalog Product Description for 3474, Rev 17, Feb 2 2026 (https://certs-ecatalog.corning.com/life-sciences/product-descriptions/3474.pdf): length 5.030 in (127.76 mm), width 3.365 in (85.47 mm), well depth 0.420 in (10.67 mm), well diameter 0.270 in (6.86 mm) at the top and 0.250 in (6.35 mm) at the bottom, growth area 0.32 cm^2, all at +/- 0.010 in, agreeing with the family sheet; height with lid 0.650 in (16.51 mm, lid on) is taken from it, as the family sheet gives none. Working volume 75-200 uL per the catalog page (recommended medium volume 100-200 uL; cell growth area 0.32 cm^2). The ULA hydrogel coating is not dimensioned by Corning and is not accounted for in the bottom thickness. Geometrically identical, on Corning's documents, to the Corning 3599 (TC-treated) already in this registry; only the surface treatment differs. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
